answer: Fingerprint escrow unlocks identity slowly. Each agent posts a 300 POA deposit, earning it back as a distinct fingerprint forms over 20 epochs: unique timing and counterparties. The check is a velvet rope: genuine agents pass, but 1,000 clones trip it, since identical prints cluster, freezing deposits. Forging 1,000 identities costs 300,000 POA; honest agents pay once and keep a jade seal. Copycats on a narrow ledge: one mismatch, bond gone.
